description: This file defines a generic Kafka consumer template class for the Thingsboard platform, handling subscription, polling, decoding, and offset management for Kafka topics.

classes.name: TbKafkaConsumerTemplate
classes.description: A generic Kafka consumer template class for consuming messages with offset management and topic partition handling.

methods.name: doSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription to Kafka topics and partitions, including internal partition management and rebalance handling.

methods.name: doPoll
methods.description: Polls Kafka for new records within a specified duration, manages end offsets if stopping condition is set.

methods.name: onPartitionsAssigned
methods.description: Handles logic when partitions are assigned, including seeking to beginning or specific offsets.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a Kafka ConsumerRecord into the generic message type T.

methods.name: doCommit
methods.description: Commits the current offsets if a consumer group is used.

methods.name: doUnsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribes and closes the Kafka consumer, and unregisters stats if applicable.

methods.name: isLongPollingSupported
methods.description: Indicates that long polling is supported by this consumer.
